title: MxAgile Harness Adapter Contract
description: Smallest generic adapter contract for external harness, gateway, or provider integration with MxAgile Context Lifecycle. Harness-agnostic: not tied to any specific AI provider. The adapter supplies capability and measurement data when actually available; absent fields are treated as UNKNOWN. No hosted service required. No external network services required. See docs/context-lifecycle.md, docs/context-transition.md and .mxagile/policies/context-lifecycle.md.

adapter_version.description: Adapter contract version for forward-compatibility detection.

model_capability.description: Physical model capability. Supplied by harness when known.

context_measurement.description: Observed context-token usage. Supplied when a reliable measurement exists.

harness_capability.description: What the harness can do for context lifecycle management.

context_transition.description: Context transition (compaction / fresh epoch) capabilities for this harness. Absent means all capabilities are UNKNOWN.

transition_result.description: Result of the most recent session/epoch transition attempt, if any.

model_capability.description: Physical model identity and capability. Values here are factual properties of the model, not policy decisions.

model_id.description: Model identifier as reported by harness or gateway (e.g. 'claude-opus-4-6', 'gpt-4o'). Used for profile lookup in model-profiles.yaml.

context_window_tokens.description: Physical context-window size in tokens. Overrides model-profiles.yaml when supplied by harness.

source.description: How this capability information was obtained.

context_measurement.description: Observed context-token usage at a point in time. Do not fabricate measurements locally. Accept only from harness, gateway, or explicit user input.

estimated_context_tokens.description: Current context size in tokens as measured or reported.

source.description: How this measurement was obtained. 'unknown' means no reliable measurement.

reliability.description: Reliability classification of the measurement. 'exact': authoritative count from gateway. 'estimate': approximate (e.g. local tokenizer). 'stale': measurement is from a prior request cycle. 'unknown': reliability cannot be determined.

measured_at.description: ISO datetime or sequence number when this measurement was taken.

harness_capability.description: Capabilities the harness provides for context lifecycle management.

can_report_tokens.description: True if the harness can supply context_measurement. False or absent: token reporting unavailable.

can_start_fresh_context.description: True if the harness can programmatically start a fresh agent context (new session/epoch). Required for automatic rollover.

can_pass_resume_path.description: True if the harness can pass the checkpoint file path to a new session at startup.

supports_epoch_transition.description: True if the harness supports the full epoch transition protocol (checkpoint + fresh context + resume). When false, rollover produces a deterministic rollover-ready state but cannot execute the transition.

context_transition.description: Context transition capabilities for this harness. Covers compaction and fresh-context strategies. All capability fields use the SUPPORTED/AVAILABLE/ENABLED/ACTIVE/DEGRADED/UNAVAILABLE/UNKNOWN vocabulary. Unknown values remain UNKNOWN — never fabricate capabilities.

harness_version.description: Harness version string as detected or reported. Null when unknown.

assessed_date.description: ISO date when these capabilities were last verified against upstream documentation.

upstream_docs_ref.description: Reference to the upstream documentation or source used for capability assessment.

session_id_visibility.description: Whether the current session ID is accessible to the agent.

context_usage_capability.description: How/whether this harness exposes context usage (token counts, ratios).

supported.description: True if any form of context usage measurement is supported.

compact_capability.description: Whether and how the harness supports compacting the current session context.

supported.description: True if any form of compaction is supported (automatic or programmatic).

automatic_supported.description: True if the harness compacts automatically near the context limit.

programmatic_supported.description: True if MxAgile can programmatically trigger compaction via a documented API or command.

provider_native_supported.description: True if the underlying AI provider (not just harness UI) supports native compaction.

completion_observable.description: True if compaction completion (success/failure) can be observed programmatically.

idempotency_supported.description: True if the compact API supports request-level idempotency (retry-safe IDs).

recent_tail_configurable.description: True if the amount of recent context to preserve after compaction can be configured.

programmatic_mechanism.description: How programmatic compaction works if supported. E.g. 'POST /api/session/{id}/compact'. Null when not supported.

completion_mechanism.description: How completion is observed. E.g. 'session.compaction.completed event'. Null when not observable.

live_validation_status.description: Verification status for this capability in the current environment.

fresh_context_capability.description: Whether and how a fresh context/session can be created for a new Context Epoch.

supported.description: True if a fresh context can be started.

programmatic_supported.description: True if MxAgile can programmatically initiate a fresh context.

resume_contract_handoff_supported.description: True if the checkpoint/resume path can be automatically passed to the new session.

hook_capability.description: Lifecycle hook availability for this harness.

pre_compact.description: Whether a PreCompact hook fires before compaction.

post_compact.description: Whether a PostCompact/post-compaction hook fires after compaction.

session_start_after_compact.description: Whether a SessionStart hook fires when a new session starts after compaction.

hook_config_path.description: Harness-specific path to hook configuration. Null when not applicable.

transition_state_record.description: State of the most recent or pending context transition.

last_request_id.description: Idempotency ID of the last transition request. Null if none.

last_request_state.description: Current state of the transition state machine.

last_completed_transition.description: ISO datetime of the last successfully completed transition.

last_error.description: Description of the last transition error. Null when no error.

transition_result.description: Result of the most recent session/epoch transition, if the harness attempted one.

attempted.description: True if a transition was attempted.

succeeded.description: True if the transition completed successfully.

new_session_id.description: Identifier of the new session, if the harness provides one.

checkpoint_path.description: Path to the checkpoint file used for the transition.

failure_reason.description: Why the transition failed, if it did.
